label: Postdog Records
note: Postdog Records の 5 組のデビュー曲。歌詞の核（サビ）は管理表『歌詞の試作』をそのまま使い、前後を年表に合わせて書き足した。style と lyrics に実在のアーティスト名・機種名は入れていない。

songs.title: Side B
songs.why_ja: 父のカセットを 401 号線で初めて聴いた夜の歌。名前（Fay）と父のテープという、この人の始まりそのものなので 1 曲目に。
songs.style: synthwave, night pop, sophisti-pop, 96 BPM, steady tempo, warm low male baritone crooner, close-mic, breathy, sung behind the beat, faint soft Irish lilt, spoken-word intro and bridge, warm analog polysynth pads with slow attack and gentle chorus, alternating 16th-note analog arpeggio, 1980s drum machine with gated reverb snare, kick on 1 and 3, round fat synth bass, thin bell-like synth counter-melody in the chorus, faint tape hiss and wow and flutter, one distant chorused clean guitar, radio tuning noise intro, minor key with a warm resolve, nocturnal, intimate, amber streetlights, slow fade-out ending
songs.exclude: EDM drop, four-on-the-floor, shouting, guitar solo, saxophone, sudden silence, autotune, bright happy major
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Radio tuning noise, a cassette clicks in]
[Spoken]
Two-forty a.m. Westbound on the 401.
Tape one of forty-three.

[Verse 1]
A shoebox came in April, brown tape across the lid
Forty-three cassettes in your careful capitals
FRIDAY, LATE — DON'T TAPE OVER
I put the first one in on the 401

[Pre-Chorus]
Mile after mile of sodium light
Hiss like the rain that isn't falling tonight

[Chorus]
Flip it over, let it run
Side B starts where the city's done
Your voice comes up at 2:40 through the hiss
Hold on now, lad, I'm recording this

[Verse 2]
Nineteen years in Granddad's garage
Under a sheet with the green sedan
Every label dated, every hour written down
Like you knew somebody'd need the plan

[Pre-Chorus]
Exit signs counting down in green
Somebody's late-night radio in between

[Chorus]
Flip it over, let it run
Side B starts where the city's done
Your voice comes up at 2:40 through the hiss
Hold on now, lad, I'm recording this

[Bridge]
[Spoken]
You'd be sixty-two this year.
I left the counter where you stopped it.
Rewind. Play.

[Final Chorus]
Flip it over, let it run
Side B starts where the city's done
Your voice comes up at 2:40 through the hiss
Hold on now, lad, I'm recording this

[Outro]
[Low humming of the chorus melody]
[Tape hiss, slow fade]

songs.title: Services at Three
songs.why_ja: 父の入院中、隔週で乗った夜行バスの 4 時間半。歌わずに声の切れ端だけで場面を作る、この人のやり方がいちばん分かる曲。
songs.style: deep house, lo-fi house, downtempo, 112 BPM, hypnotic and warm, soft rounded four-on-the-floor kick, 1970s electric piano playing soft 9th and 11th chords slightly behind the beat, chopped breath and wordless vocal fragments pitched in semitones, round sub bass, gentle tape wobble and faint vinyl crackle, swung 16th shaker and quiet rimshot ghost notes, muffled clean guitar two-note highlife riff, distant ventilation hum, late-night coach ride on a motorway, patient arrangement adding one element every 16 bars, mid-section where the kick drifts away, no drop
songs.exclude: rap, supersaw lead, big riser, EDM drop, pitched-up chipmunk vocals, full sung verses, sudden silence
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Soft kick, electric piano chords, distant engine hum]

[Hook: whispered vocal chops]
still here
still here
northbound, still
still here

[Groove]
[Breath chops, swung shaker, sub bass enters]

[Courtyard]
[Kick drifts away, keys and breath only]

[Hook: vocal chops, one semitone higher]
still here
still here
northbound, still
still here

[Groove]
[Muffled two-note guitar riff joins]

[Outro]
[Breath, keys and engine hum fade out]

songs.title: Due East
songs.why_ja: 春分の日の出に生まれた自分の歌。名前（Easterly）の由来と、朝の高速のまっすぐな高揚をいちばん素直に伝えられる。
songs.style: synth-pop, indie pop, electropop, 116 BPM, motorik steady pulse, clear bright high female vocal, crisp consonants, light falsetto only at the peak, bright analog-style 8th-note synth arpeggio, muted clean electric guitar 16th-note cuts, short bouncy synth bass, dry punchy snare and handclaps, high bell synth in the chorus only, filter slowly opening into each chorus, chorus by 0:30, catchy post-chorus ah-ah hook, sunrise on an open highway, optimistic, dry close production
songs.exclude: rap, distorted guitar, heavy autotune, sudden silence, sad ending, dark nightclub, trap hi-hats
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Bright synth arpeggio plays the chorus melody]

[Verse 1]
Dad wrote it on the whiteboard the morning I was born
Six-oh-eight, roads clear and dry, frost on the orchard floor
Twenty-four years later I'm still up before the plow
Cocoa in the cupholder, and the Gorge is waking now

[Pre-Chorus]
Ramp to eighty-four
Light coming under the door

[Chorus]
March the twentieth, the sun is on the center line
Visor up at sixty, I'm a minute ahead of time
Twice a year it rises right where this road is aimed
Due east, due east, me and the day are pointed the same

[Post-Chorus]
Ah-ah, ah-ah
Pointed the same
Ah-ah, ah-ah

[Verse 2]
Racks rolled out at half past three, twenty borrowed keys
Bread left warm in every porch light, nobody sees me
Now the river's turning silver and the mile signs flicker by
I don't need a reason, I just like to meet it eye to eye

[Pre-Chorus]
Ramp to eighty-four
Light coming under the door
Hold it, hold it

[Chorus]
March the twentieth, the sun is on the center line
Visor up at sixty, I'm a minute ahead of time
Twice a year it rises right where this road is aimed
Due east, due east, me and the day are pointed the same

[Post-Chorus]
Ah-ah, ah-ah
Pointed the same
Ah-ah, ah-ah

[Bridge]
[Phone call voice, filtered]
Sunrise six-fifty-two. Roads clear and dry.
Text me when you're there.

[Chorus]
March the twentieth, the sun is on the center line
Visor up at sixty, I'm a minute ahead of time
Twice a year it rises right where this road is aimed
Due east, due east, me and the day are pointed the same

[Post-Chorus]
Ah-ah, ah-ah
Pointed the same
Ah-ah, ah-ah

[Outro]
[Arpeggio alone, bright and steady, fades]

songs.title: Two Lanes Over
title_alt: The Whole Road Is Your Room
songs.why_ja: 工場の閉鎖のあとトラック運転手になった父と、Hume Freeway で並んで走る歌。昼の光と 3 人の演奏、明るく率直なこのバンドらしさが一番出る。
songs.style: city pop, sunlit indie rock, funk pop, jangle pop, 118 BPM, 16th-note groove, warm male mid-range lead sung slightly behind the beat, conversational, bright female harmony a third above in the chorus, clean single-coil electric guitar 16th-note cuts with light chorus, melodic fingerstyle electric bass with round short flatwound tone, 1970s drum kit with dry wooden snare, cross-stick in the verses, 16th hi-hats, soft bell-like electric piano, 12-string acoustic shimmering under the chorus, tambourine and shaker, two-bar guitar and bass unison riff after the second chorus, brief key change in the bridge, open highway in daylight, tight ending hit
songs.exclude: EDM drop, horn section, heavy distortion, autotune effect, long silence, ballad
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Clean guitar cuts, bass and hi-hats]

[Verse 1]
You kept your plant badge in the glovebox
Under the rosary and the fuel receipts
You call me from Wallan at a quarter past one
Just to tell me which pie you'd eat

[Pre-Chorus]
I'm heading north with the band in the back
You're heading home on the same black track

[Chorus]
Flash my lights and you flash them back
Two lanes over on the Hume
Twenty-two years you hung doors on cars
Now the whole road is your room

[Verse 2]
The day they shut the gates you didn't say much
Wrote three years on the kitchen wall
Now you know every servo from here to Sydney
By the colour of the chairs in the hall

[Pre-Chorus]
I'm heading north with the band in the back
You're heading home on the same black track

[Chorus]
Flash my lights and you flash them back
Two lanes over on the Hume
Twenty-two years you hung doors on cars
Now the whole road is your room

[Instrumental Break]
[Two-bar guitar and bass unison riff]

[Bridge]
March is coming, your last run north
I'll be beside you, I'll keep the time
One more pie at the Holbrook stop
You on your side, me on mine

[Final Chorus]
Flash my lights and you flash them back
Two lanes over on the Hume
Twenty-two years you hung doors on cars
Now the whole road is your room

[Final Chorus]
Flash my lights and you flash them back
Two lanes over on the Hume
Twenty-two years you hung doors on cars
Now the whole road is your room

[Outro]
[Band hits together, end]

songs.title: The Low Part
songs.why_ja: 12 時間の時差で暮らした 2 人が、声のファイルで 1 つのハモりを作っていた歌。男女のハモりというこの 2 人の核そのもの。
songs.style: acoustic pop, indie folk, folk pop, 90 BPM, gentle sway, intimate male-female duet, warm female lead with soft New Zealand vowels, low male harmony and oohs underneath, close-mic warm vocals with breath, fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar in open D tuning with thumb bass, small mahogany guitar soft strums, pump organ drone on the fifth, upright bass, brushed snare and floor tom, light mandolin chops in thirds, one cello holding long notes, faint rain and creaking wood field recording, chorus fragment hummed within 30 seconds, bridge with only two voices and organ, homely and tender
songs.exclude: synth pads, electronic drop, belting, autotune effect, stadium chant, silence break, heavy drums
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Fingerpicked guitar and organ drone]
[Humming the chorus melody]

[Verse 1: Female]
Frost on the gatepost, the dogs at my heel
Seven o'clock and the paddocks are steel
You'd be locking the boatyard, rain on the slip
Humming a line with a pencil at your lip

[Chorus: Duet]
Your night comes in as a file on my phone
I play it out loud in the woolshed alone
Half a world of water and a cold cup of tea
You sing the low part and leave the top for me

[Verse 2: Male]
Seven at night and the river's gone grey
I sing it twice and I send it away
Somewhere it's morning, you're out with the sheep
I leave the high line for you to keep

[Chorus: Duet]
Your night comes in as a file on my phone
I play it out loud in the woolshed alone
Half a world of water and a cold cup of tea
You sing the low part and leave the top for me

[Bridge: Voices and organ only]
Twelve hours apart and the same little tune
One of us up with the sun, one with the moon
Ooh, ooh

[Final Chorus: Duet]
Your night comes in as a file on my phone
I play it out loud in the woolshed alone
Half a world of water and a cold cup of tea
You sing the low part and leave the top for me

[Final Chorus: Duet]
Half a world of water and a cold cup of tea
You sing the low part and leave the top for me

[Outro]
[Rain and creaking wood, guitar fades]
